Experience the profound serenity of “Shanti Naad”, a soothing sarod performance by legendary maestro Ustad Amjad Ali Khan. Let the soulful resonance of the sarod create a peaceful atmosphere for relaxation, meditation, reflection, and mindful listening.
Credit's:
Artist: Ustad Amjad Ali Khan
instrument : Sarod
Benefits of Listening to Raga Bhoopali
• Creates a peaceful and uplifting mood
• Helps encourage mental calm and relaxation
• Supports meditation, mindfulness, and quiet reflection
